caption: The video captures a close view of the flat dark-gray top of a stove-like metal appliance, with a black cylindrical flue pipe rising from the center-back and a small brass fitting on the front lip against wooden paneling. A white wet-looking patch with a horizontal streak sits on the left of the top, while scattered white specks dot the rest of the surface. Above that patch a fountain of fine droplets is already erupting, growing taller and denser and brightening the white area beneath it. Wispy vapor swirls around the pipe base and drifts across the right side. The framing slowly shifts leftward, revealing the black cable loop and a pale wall at the far left while the pipe slides toward the right edge. The scattered white specks persist, shifting in view only with the pan. The spray and vapor continue without settling as the excerpt ends.
